chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam and Mohsin ibn Ahmad, from Aban ibn al-Ahmar, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: "Do not enter houses other than your houses until you seek permission and greet their people."
He said: Seeking permission (al-istinas) is placing the sandal, and greeting (al-salam) is sending peace.

key_terms.الاسْتِئْنَاسُ: Seeking permission or announcing one's presence before entering
key_terms.وَقْعُ النَّعْلِ: Placing the sandal (a traditional signal of arrival)

ai.seo_question: What is the practical meaning of 'istinas' and 'salam' in the verse about entering homes?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a practical, contextual interpretation of Surah An-Nur 24:27, linking the abstract concept of 'istinas' (seeking permission) to the tangible act of placing one's sandal as a signal of arrival. This explanation highlights the Prophetic tradition of modesty and respect in social interactions, emphasizing that the requirement is not merely verbal but involves observable gestures that announce one's presence to the inhabitants. Such exegetical details underscore the Shia scholarly approach of grounding Quranic injunctions in daily lived practices and cultural norms of the time.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Ali bin Hakam, and Mohsin bin Ahmad, from Aban bin Ahmar, from Abdul-Rahman bin Abi Abdillah, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «do not enter houses other than your houses until you domesticate (yourselves) and send peace upon their people.» [24:27]
He said: Domestication is to place the sandals and send peace.
